name: Deanwood Aquatic Center
directions: The pool is located within Deanwood Recreation Center. Street parking is available.

name: Dunbar Aquatic Center
directions: The pool is located in Dunbar Senior High School. The pool entrance is at O St NW and 1st St NW. Look for the double glass doors next to the pickup/drop-off driveway. Street parking is available along O St NW.

name: Gallaudet University Field House
address: Gallaudet Field House (Lincoln Cir NE, next to the track and football field)
directions: The pool is in the basement of the Field House, accessed from the back of the building. The parking lot is behind the Field House. From the rear parking lot, go north on the sidewalk towards the football field, then down the stairs to the pool facility (look for the blue and yellow lounge chairs).

name: Takoma Aquatic & Recreation Center
directions: The pool is in Takoma Recreation Center. Parking is available in the parking lot (enter near 3rd St NW and Underwood St NW). The pool entrance is on the north side of the building: from the front entrance, go downstairs and through the locker rooms to reach the pool.

name: Wakefield Aquatics Center
directions: The pool is inside Wakefield High School, reached from the main parking lot. Enter through Door #18, to the right of the flagpoles.

name: Washington-Liberty Aquatics Center
directions: The pool is inside Washington-Liberty High School. Enter through Door #7.

name: Wilson Aquatic Center
directions: On-street metered parking is available immediately outside the pool along Fort Dr NW.

name: Harry Thomas Sr. Pool
directions: The pool is next to Harry Thomas Recreation Center, just off North Capitol St and R St NE. Street parking is available.

name: Oxon Run Pool
directions: The pool is in Oxon Run Park on Mississippi Ave SE. Street parking is available.
